quests.instruction: Which word has the short I sound: "KIT" or "KITE"?
quests.question: KIT or KITE
quests.hint: A silent E at the end does not make its own sound -- but it changes the vowel before it!
quests.explanation: "KIT" has no silent E, so the I keeps its short sound.
quests.funFact: Adding a silent E turns "KIT" 🧰 into "KITE" 🪁 -- same letters, new sound!

quests.instruction: Which word has the long I sound: "SHIN" or "SHINE"?
quests.question: SHIN or SHINE
quests.hint: Look for the word that ends in a quiet, silent E.
quests.explanation: "SHINE" has a silent E, which makes the I say its own name -- that is the long I sound!
quests.funFact: Adding a silent E turns "SHIN" 🦵 into "SHINE" ✨ -- same letters, new sound!
